newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Fed May manufacturing index down 0.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Fed May manufacturing index down 0.1 pct.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago said Friday its Chicago Fed Midwest Manufacturing Index (CFMMI) fell 0.1 percent in May to 121.6, the first decline in seven months.
"This is the first time in a year and a half that every sector in the region had slower growth from the prior month than its national counterpart," the Chicago Fed said in a statement.
The Federal Reserve Board's industrial production index for manufacturing (IPMFG), which measures activity nationwide, rose 0.5 percent in May, the Chicago Fed report said.
The CFMMI index gauges industrial activity in the seventh U.S. economic district, which includes Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Michigan, and Wisconsin.
